description: A lab-local broken access control: deleting another lab user's document requires no ownership check.

evidence.notes: Lab-local fixture traffic only; document restored after the test

impact: Any lab user could delete any other lab user's document.
proof_of_concept: As lab user B, DELETE /lab/docs/owned-by-A returns 200 and the document is gone; the response confirms the deletion.
remediation: Check document ownership before deleting, and return 403 otherwise.
steps_to_reproduce: Log in as lab user B
Observe the 200 response and the missing document
title: Broken access control on lab document delete
